Hi! I'm CompliLet 👋, {{1}}'s screening assistant.

I help landlords verify tenant applications quickly and securely. I'll ask you a few questions and collect some documents — it usually takes about 10 minutes.

Reply *YES* to begin your screening, or *STOP* to decline.

Your information is handled in line with UK GDPR and will only be shared with {{1}}.
